description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Edit' feature for articles in a web application, including command models, validation, and the handler logic for updating articles in the database.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Contains the command, model, validator, and handler classes for editing articles.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the article edit command, updating the article and its tags in the database.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be created for the article.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which tags should be removed from the article.
